numinance.kinds.v1.LockedTool.jsonschema.description:
LockedTool pins one tool of one plugin connection by the hash of its canonicalised description, schemas and
 annotations (design sections 14 and 17), or the hash of the signed overlay that declares it. It replaces
 LockedKnowledgeTool, which names no plugin.

connection.description: connection is the name of the plugin's configured connection (the instance of an AdapterTool).

name.description: name is the tool name as the server lists it.

plugin.description:
plugin is the plugin_id of the extension that serves the tool: a reverse-DNS identifier of at least two labels,
 as LockedExtension.id.

numinance.kinds.v1.LockedTool.jsonschema.title: Locked Tool

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
